about_short_description.short_description: SCL is a school management system with educational and management modules.

product.name: Student Information System
product.description: A centralized platform for managing student data, attendance, behavior, and communication within educational institutions.

product.name: Learning Management System
product.description: A platform for creating and managing interactive assignments, plagiarism checks, reporting, and generating academic transcripts and reports.

product.name: Virtual Classrooms
product.description: A feature that enables instant creation of virtual classrooms with automated attendance and session recording for teachers.

product.name: Billing & Fees Management
product.description: A centralized system to manage tuition, course, and transportation fees with support for multiple payment gateways.

product.name: Parent Portal
product.description: A portal that allows parents to access academic progress, attendance, payments, communication, and school event information.

product.name: Timetable
product.description: A course-based scheduling system that supports various school scheduling systems and integrates with external timetable software.
